label: rem:cyclotomic-reduction
title: Cyclotomic reduction and $C_{\mathfrak{p}}$ preservation
html:
Let \mathfrak{p} be a prime (not to be confused with a point p\in M). Working over the cyclotomic ring

\mathbb{Z}_{\zeta_{\mathfrak{p}}}
   := \mathbb{Z}[i,\zeta_{\mathfrak{p}}],

where \zeta_{\mathfrak{p}}=e^{2\pi i/\mathfrak{p}} is a primitive \mathfrak{p}-th root of unity, we examine the sublocus

  S_{\mathfrak{p}}
   := 
  \Sigma_4\cap\mathbb{Z}_{\zeta_{\mathfrak{p}}}^{5}.

This defines the set of points on Bring's surface whose resolvent coordinates lie in \mathbb{Z}_{\zeta_{\mathfrak{p}}}. The cyclic subgroup C_{\mathfrak{p}}\subset S_5 generated by the \mathfrak{p}-cycle preserves S_{\mathfrak{p}}. For any P\in S_{\mathfrak{p}}, the image \sigma^k(P) remains in \mathbb{Z}_{\zeta_{\mathfrak{p}}}^{5} because \sigma multiplies by \zeta_{\mathfrak{p}}^{-k} in the resolvent basis (Lagrange resolvents), and \zeta_{\mathfrak{p}}^{-k}\in\mathbb{Z}_{\zeta_{\mathfrak{p}}}. This arithmetic compatibility between the cyclic symmetry and the cyclotomic ring exhibits the descent of the C_5 action to finite characteristic.
